purpose: LRM 4.6.4.6: one noise source contributed to two branches is fully correlated, sign included

oracle.derivation: One source n, S = 1e-18 A^2/Hz, drawn out of node a (coeff +1) and out of node b with coeff -1. Vin is an AC short: Z(a) = 1k||1k = 500 ohm, Z(b) = 1k, no coupling. v(a) = -500 n, v(b) = +1000 n, v(a,b) = -1500 n, so onoise = 1500*1e-9 = 1.5e-6 V/sqrt(Hz). Independent rows give sqrt(500^2+1000^2)*1e-9 = 1.118e-6; a lost sign gives 5e-7.
